eps.o: When Lori takes a gap year from college, the Loud kids are determined to have her move back in with them.
Royal Woods' best bakers, Clyde and Nana Gayle, decide to get their own food truck together.
To win their school film festival, Lincoln and Clyde cast Lynn as their movie’s extreme stunt double.

eps.t: Be Careful What You Fish For
eps.o: A fishing trip with Gramps turns into an obsessive chase when Gramps' old fish rival, Moby Rick, swims nearby.
For her try-out for the Varsity Mime Team, Luan must be silent for an entire day.
Afraid of failing her PE exam again, Lucy recruits the Morticians Club to help her pass.
When Darcy's birthday party falls on the same day as one of Lisa's hero scientist's talks, Lisa sends TODD in her place to the party.
Flip sees a lucrative business opportunity when he discovers Nacho has the ability to predict the weather.

eps.t: Close Encounters of the Nerd Kind
eps.o: Dressed as the intergalactic crew from their new favorite movie, Planet Protection Patrol, Lincoln and his friends are ready to trick or treat. But things take an eerie turn when people around Royal Woods start disappearing.
Lincoln and friends try to befriend new girl Kara when they learn she has access to a legendary missing comic book.
Miguel enlists Leni's help when he launches his own perfume line at Reininger's.
Dad struggles to run Lynn's Table when his brother Lance opens up a gym above the restaurant.
Privy to all the gossip at school, Lola is recruited to write her own gossip column in the school newspaper.
To commemorate their video hitting 10,000 streams, the Moon Goats agree to all get matching tattoos.
When Lisa's science club holds a fundraiser, she struggles to master the art of salesmanship.
To help Lori out, Luan gets her a job at the Burnt Bean, where Luan is the boss.
Lana struggles to shake off Lily when she starts to follow Lana around like a shadow.

eps.t: Europe Road Trip: A Knight to Remember
eps.o: The Louds travel to London when Luna receives an invitation to Mick Swagger's knighting ceremony but get caught up in a special mission when Lincoln runs into a familiar face.

eps.t: Europe Road Trip: Nonna Your Business
eps.o: The Louds journey to Naples, Italy to taste the world's best pizza, made by a secretive and legendary chef.
When Lynn crushes on a boy in the Swiss Alps, Lori and Leni become her crush coaches to help her talk to him.

eps.t: Europe Road Trip: A Bite in Transylvania
eps.o: When the Louds' bus gets a flat tire, they're invited to stay the night in a spooky couple's mysterious castle.

eps.t: Europe Road Trip: Greece Is the Word
eps.o: During a tour of the Parthenon, Lincoln puts on a soldier's helmet which sends him back to Ancient Greece.
